name: Product Builder
tagline: Turn a product idea into a working software organization.
mainOutcome: Translate business intent into requirements, architecture, implementation and a deployment-ready product.

fields.label: Product / application name
fields.sample: AI Expense Manager

fields.label: What are you building?
fields.sample: A SaaS platform that helps small businesses capture expenses, approve reimbursements and track spending.

fields.label: Primary users
fields.sample: SMB employees, managers and finance administrators

fields.label: Core features
fields.sample: Expense capture, receipt upload, manager approvals, reimbursement status, finance dashboard

fields.label: Business objective
fields.sample: Launch an MVP that can onboard the first 20 pilot companies.

fields.label: Preferred launch environment
fields.sample: AWS

fields.label: Budget range
fields.sample: ₹2–5 lakh MVP budget

fields.label: Security / compliance constraints
fields.sample: Basic PII protection; production secrets must remain outside prompts and memory.

fields.label: What should you personally control?
fields.sample: Product scope and final production release approval

name: Application Developer
tagline: Build, test, debug and maintain software with an AI engineering team.
mainOutcome: Give developers a technical team for bounded implementation, testing, debugging and delivery work.

fields.label: Project / repository name
fields.sample: payments-service

fields.label: Repository URL
fields.sample: https://github.com/acme/payments-service

fields.label: Primary technology stack
fields.sample: Python 3.12, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, React

fields.label: Current requirement / task
fields.sample: Implement idempotent payment creation API with validation, tests and structured error handling.

fields.label: Test requirements
fields.sample: Unit + integration tests; target ≥85% coverage for changed modules.

fields.label: Development environment
fields.sample: Local + dev Kubernetes namespace

fields.label: Staging environment
fields.sample: AWS EKS staging

fields.label: Coding standards / constraints
fields.sample: PEP 8, Ruff, mypy, conventional commits, secure secrets handling

name: Architecture Studio
tagline: Design systems, compare technology choices and produce implementation-ready architecture.
mainOutcome: Produce architecture, ADRs, technology comparisons, security analysis and implementation roadmaps.

fields.label: System / project name
fields.sample: Enterprise Knowledge Platform

fields.label: Business requirements
fields.sample: Serve 50k employees, provide search and RAG over policy documents, integrate with SSO and existing HR systems.

fields.label: Existing architecture / systems
fields.sample: Existing Azure landing zone, PostgreSQL, Kafka, Entra ID and corporate API gateway.

fields.label: Cloud / platform preference
fields.sample: Azure

fields.label: Availability / scalability targets
fields.sample: 99.9% availability; p95 API latency < 500 ms; horizontal scaling required.

fields.label: Security / compliance requirements
fields.sample: SSO, RBAC, encryption in transit and at rest, auditable access, data residency requirements.

fields.label: Cost constraint
fields.sample: Target cloud spend below ₹3 lakh/month during pilot

name: Platform & SRE
tagline: Operate infrastructure, CI/CD, observability and reliability with controlled automation.
mainOutcome: Automate bounded infrastructure and reliability work while preserving strict production controls.

fields.label: Cloud provider
fields.sample: AWS

fields.label: Existing infrastructure
fields.sample: EKS, RDS PostgreSQL, ElastiCache, S3, CloudWatch and Terraform-managed networking.

fields.label: CI/CD system
fields.sample: GitHub Actions

fields.label: Deployment environments
fields.sample: dev, test, staging, production

fields.label: Reliability objectives / SLOs
fields.sample: 99.9% availability; RTO 30 min; RPO 15 min; p95 service latency < 500 ms.

fields.label: Access scope
fields.sample: Development/Staging read-write. Production read by default; production apply requires approval.

fields.label: Observability requirements
fields.sample: Centralized logs, metrics, traces, deployment markers and alert routing to the on-call channel.

name: Data & ML Engineering
tagline: Coordinate data, ML, MLOps and AI engineering workflows.
mainOutcome: Move from curated data to evaluated, deployable ML/AI systems with reproducible workflows.

fields.label: Project / model name
fields.sample: Customer Churn Prediction

fields.label: Business / ML objective
fields.sample: Predict customers at risk of churn and expose predictions through a monitored API.

fields.label: Data sources
fields.sample: Curated PostgreSQL customer data, support interactions and product usage events.

fields.label: Sensitive data constraints
fields.sample: PII present; access limited to approved datasets and masked development copies.

fields.label: Preferred model / stack
fields.sample: XGBoost + scikit-learn + MLflow; FastAPI inference

fields.label: Evaluation criteria
fields.sample: Recall ≥ 0.75 for the positive class, calibration review and drift monitoring.

fields.label: Training / serving environment
fields.sample: AWS, GPU optional, MLflow tracking, Kubernetes inference

name: Autonomous Software Factory
tagline: End-to-end software delivery with autonomy constrained by explicit policy.
mainOutcome: Plan, build, test, deploy, monitor and recover across the software lifecycle within explicit policy boundaries.

fields.label: Software product / goal
fields.sample: Build and operate a multi-tenant expense management SaaS from requirements through production.

fields.label: Target users / customers
fields.sample: SMB finance teams in India

fields.label: Source control / issue tracker
fields.sample: GitHub + GitHub Issues

fields.label: Cloud / runtime
fields.sample: AWS

fields.label: What must always require human approval?
fields.sample: Production deployment, destructive migrations, privileged IAM changes, secrets rotation and external customer messages.

fields.label: Maximum operating budget
fields.sample: ₹50,000/month for pilot infrastructure and model usage

fields.label: Emergency-stop owner
fields.sample: Platform owner + engineering lead

name: Custom Organization
tagline: Define the organization, policies, tools, skills and autonomy yourself.
mainOutcome: Build a bespoke AI organization while keeping platform-level safety, audit and policy controls intact.
approvalGates: User must explicitly define policies before activation

fields.label: Organization name
fields.sample: AI Platform Engineering Org

fields.label: Mission
fields.sample: Operate a reusable AI platform team that can design, build and maintain internal developer tooling.

fields.label: Profiles / roles
fields.sample: Platform Lead, Backend Engineer, Cloud Engineer, SRE, Security Engineer

fields.label: Org hierarchy / collaboration
fields.sample: Platform Lead coordinates Cloud + Backend + SRE; Security can review any production-affecting change.

fields.label: Professional knowledge packs
fields.sample: Cloud architecture, Kubernetes, CI/CD, Security, Python, FastAPI, Terraform

fields.label: Reusable skills
fields.sample: Repository analysis, incident analysis, Terraform review, deployment, architecture review

fields.label: MCPs / external tools
fields.sample: GitHub, AWS, Kubernetes, Grafana, Jira, PostgreSQL

fields.label: Autonomy level
fields.sample: A3 — Delegate

fields.label: Access model
fields.sample: Dev/Staging read-write; Production read; apply operations approval-required; secrets never exposed directly.

fields.label: Approval gates
fields.sample: Production deployment, IAM privilege changes, destructive actions, secrets, high-cost resources

fields.label: Budget policy
fields.sample: ₹25,000/month total; high-cost model use requires approval above threshold.
